name: GGV AI & DS — Request Intake Queue

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { status: 'pending_review', message: 'Request saved for staff review. No email was sent.' } }}

parameters.content:
SETUP BEFORE ACTIVATION
1) Configure Header Auth on the webhook and the same header name/value in Vercel as N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET. Suggested header: x-ggv-automation-secret.
2) Configure the two Supabase REST headers using an n8n secret/credential containing the Manushyaa service-role key. Never commit real secrets.
3) Apply the Supabase migration first.
4) This workflow only creates a notice in pending_review. It does not publish it or send email. Staff must review before public release.
5) Add rate limiting/abuse controls on the Vercel endpoint before public launch.
